data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental with no license in 2033? You're in the right place. We've fixed our prices for the year, so you know exactly what you'll pay – no surprises. Whether you want a 2-hour spin to Cala del Faro or a full-day cruise to Estepona, our fleet is ready. All boats include a licensed skipper, so no paperwork is needed. Here's your complete cost overview.

No License? No Problem – How It Works

In Spain, you can charter a boat up to 24m without a license if a professional skipper is on board. All our boats – from the 6.4m Mariah SX21 to the 29m Ferretti 94 – come with a skipper included. You just turn up, relax, and enjoy the Costa del Sol. No exams, no permits, no stress.

2033 Pricing Tiers: At a Glance

We've simplified our pricing into two fixed tiers for 2033. Other boats are available on request.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA (21%). No hidden fees.

Tier A: Affordable No-License Boat Rental (from €749)

Our Tier A boats – the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – are perfect for small groups. For €749 for 2 hours, you get a full crew, drinks, and snacks. Extend to 4 hours (€1,299) for a trip to Cabopino or 8 hours (€2,299) for a day exploring the Marbella coastline. These are our most popular no-license options.

Tier B: Luxury No-Lice nse Charter with Jet Ski (from €4,719)

If you want something bigger, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – available in white or grey – starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. That includes a free jet ski. Perfect for a VIP experience in Puerto Banús. For longer durations, request a quote via WhatsApp.

Other Boats (Prices on Request)

We have a wide range of other no-license boats, all departing from Puerto Banús. Here's a quick overview:

  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – ideal for sunset cruises
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – spacious luxury

  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) – compact and affordable
  • Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) – budget-friendly
  • Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) – versatile

Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing on any of these.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every no-license boat rental includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no tax surprises

You can also add catering, champagne, or water toys on request.

Popular Destinations from Puerto Banús

All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. Popular routes include:

  • Cala del Faro – a secluded cove 15 minutes away
  • Cabopino – 30 minutes east, with sandy beaches
  • Estepona – 45 minutes west, charming old town
  • Marbella Marina – stop for lunch on the Golden Mile
  • Sotogrande – 1 hour west, luxury port

Your skipper will tailor the itinerary to your preferences.

How to Book Your No-License Boat Rental

Booking is simple. For Tier A and B boats with fixed prices, you can book directly on our website. For other boats, send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We'll respond within 2 hours with availability and a custom quote. No deposit needed for most bookings – just confirm 48 hours in advance.
